title: Murmuring Rootway
message: Roots murmur as you pass. "The new one," whispers a thick coil, only for another to shush it sharply. The gossip grows louder and increasingly specific until it leads beneath a knotted root, where {reward} Star Candies and a folded Travel Note have been tucked away.

title: Lanternvine Crossing
message: Lanternvines brighten into a suspiciously perfect trail. The moment you trust it, every lantern goes dark. After a long, smug pause, they relight farther ahead around {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note; the vines flicker as though laughing.

title: Whispercap Circle
message: A circle of Whispercaps begins copying the rhythm of your footsteps. One mushroom lands every beat painfully late. Investigating the terrible percussionist reveals a Travel Note beneath its cap and {reward} Star Candies nestled around its roots.

title: Veilpetal Drift
message: Veilpetals keep attaching themselves to your sleeves, boots, and hair until you resemble an ambulatory bouquet. One carries a folded Travel Note; when you remove it, the others flutter apart to reveal {reward} Star Candies they had been concealing.

title: Rootcoil Bend
message: A root blocks the obvious trail. You step around it, and another slides into place. After several increasingly petty repetitions, the forest apparently grows bored and opens the way, exposing {reward} Star Candies beside a waiting Travel Note.

title: Dewbell Canopy
message: Dewbells chime whenever you move. Trying to sneak only makes them ring louder until one enormous magical *DONG* rolls through the canopy, shaking loose a Travel Note and {reward} Star Candies in a shower of silver droplets.

title: Briarfin Trail
message: Briar-like kelp plucks a harmless trinket from your bag and passes it from vine to vine. The chase winds through half the trail before the briars return it with theatrical innocence beside {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Hushwater Grove
message: Every sound vanishes inside the grove. A wooden sign says, "SHHH." Familiar handwriting beneath it adds, "they are dramatic." The silence holds until reeds part without a sound, revealing {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Fae-Lure Lights
message: Fae lights divide into several beautiful paths beside a scratched warning: "DON'T FOLLOW THE BLUE ONES." Immediately, every light turns blue. After an exhausting argument conducted entirely through pointing, one reluctantly guides you to {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Mosscloak Hollow
message: A moss-covered lump looks exactly like buried treasure. It contains one damp pebble. A second, even more suspicious lump nearby proves far more honest, unfolding to reveal {reward} Star Candies and a carefully wrapped Travel Note.

title: Singing Vineway
message: Living vines weave a beautiful melody through the current until one begins improvising terribly. Its neighbors wrap around the offending musician until it stops. The scuffle dislodges a Travel Note and {reward} Star Candies from the woven canopy.

title: Moonblossom Clearing
message: Moonblossoms turn toward you one by one, filling the clearing with pale light. Then every flower abruptly turns away and points toward the same patch of earth. Beneath their silent attention rest {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Gossipcurrent Fork
message: The current whispers, "Shizuki got lost here." Another adds, "Twice." A third corrects it: "Four times." An old Travel Note wedged between the roots insists this absolutely did not happen, while the delighted gossip carries you toward {reward} Star Candies.

title: Vanishing Grove
message: The grove disappears whenever you glance away. By walking backward and refusing to break eye contact, you finally catch the forest cheating. The trees rustle with embarrassment and admit you into a hidden clearing containing {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Shrinebark Shrine
message: An old Fae shrine appears to demand an offering. Someone previously left exactly one berry beside a tiny note: "ONE. Don't get greedy. - Shizuki" The shrine seems satisfied with this arrangement and opens a rootwork drawer holding {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Starflower Patch
message: Every Starflower snaps shut as you approach except one stubborn bloom. A tiny pebble, deliberately wedged into its petals long ago, explains why. Inside the propped-open flower rest {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note marked with familiar berry doodles.

title: Dreamsap Pool
message: Touching the Dreamsap Pool summons what promises to be a profound vision. Instead, an old magical memory shows Shizuki arguing with a vine that stole her berry. The vision cuts off at the vine's rebuttal, and the rippling pool releases {reward} Star Candies with a Travel Note.

title: Kelpweave Arch
message: The living arch rearranges its branches into unmistakable symbols: "TURN AROUND." You continue forward. After several more increasingly stern arrangements, it opens with a weary creak and reveals {reward} Star Candies beside a Travel Note.

title: Willowcurrent Turn
message: Willow fronds point in several contradictory directions. An old arrow says, "I picked left." A second message beneath it adds, "Update: don't." Eliminating that option and following the least unhelpful fronds leads to {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Bramblejaw Understory
message: The understory forms the unmistakable shape of a gigantic mouth. It closes dramatically behind you, waits through one tense heartbeat, then opens again. Apparently satisfied with the scare, the forest uncovers {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note beneath its leafy tongue.

title: Echo-Bark Stand
message: Echo-Bark repeats every sound it has heard. From deep in the old voices comes Shizuki saying, "Don't repeat that." The entire grove immediately choruses, "Don't repeat that." Their delighted echoes converge around {reward} Star Candies and an old Travel Note.

title: Moonmoth Cloud
message: Hundreds of Moonmoths surround you, gathering shells, twigs, and loose stones without showing any aggression. They arrange everything into a gigantic arrow, which points with remarkable precision toward {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Rootbound Effigy
message: Ancient roots have grown into a vaguely humanoid effigy. Someone has fitted it with a magnificent fake mustache. When the current tilts its distinguished disguise, a hollow opens beneath the figure, revealing {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Sighing Reedbed
message: Every wrong turn makes the surrounding reeds sigh in unmistakable disappointment. You eventually navigate by choosing whichever direction earns the least judgmental reaction, reaching {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note to a final chorus of reluctant approval.

title: Glimmerpod Nursery
message: Baby Glimmerpods blink open as you approach. One suddenly spits a Star Candy at you, then another joins in, and soon the nursery is pelting you harmlessly from every side. By the time they settle down, you have gathered {reward} Star Candies and found a Travel Note among them.

title: Borrowed Grove
message: The grove has collected shells, stones from distant regions, scraps of old equipment, and harmless belongings misplaced by generations of travelers. Among the forest's extensive "borrowed" collection are {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Thornsong Vale
message: Thorned vines sing beautifully as the current passes through them, except for several suspicious additions that ruin the melody at precisely the worst moments. Following the surviving tune through the sabotage leads to {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Whisperroot Deep
message: The oldest roots whisper your recent actions back to you in perfect order. Then one calmly says something that has not happened: "Found it." A moment later the roots open beneath your hand, and there are {reward} Star Candies with a Travel Note.

title: Memory-Kelp Pool
message: Memory-kelp fills the pool with hazy impressions of earlier travelers. A familiar white-haired elf repeatedly passes the same tree until her old reflection stops, stares at it, and realizes she has walked in circles. The memory fades, leaving {reward} Star Candies and her Travel Note behind.

title: Heart of the Whisperwood
message: For once, the entire forest falls completely silent. Ancient Fae roots open around a living sanctuary untouched by time, where an old folded Travel Note shows that Shizuki once respected this place enough to leave it undisturbed. The sanctuary willingly releases {reward} Star Candies into your hands. LEGENDARY EXPEDITION!
